title: US regulator rejects Dutch fintech Bunq's application for national bank charter
excerpt: Dutch fintech Bunq said on Friday that the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) ‌had rejected its application for a national bank charter, ‌d...
content_html:
Reuters

Fri, August 7, 2026 at 3:40 PM MST 1 min read

Aug 7 (Reuters) - Dutch fintech Bunq said on Friday that the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) ‌had rejected its application for a national bank charter, ‌dealing a setback to the company's plans to expand its banking operations into the ​United States.

• "The OCC wants to see a plan more specifically built for the U.S. market, with greater demonstrated experience in the products we want to offer, and detail on our financial structure," a Bunq ‌spokesperson told Reuters in ⁠a statement.

• The OCC, in a letter dated August 4, said its denial was owing to "significant supervisory ⁠and compliance concerns".

• The OCC said the application did not clearly explain how Bunq would be capitalized in the United States and raised ​doubts about ​management's experience with unsecured credit ​cards, as well as the ‌bank's ability to operate safely and turn a profit in the competitive U.S. market.

• Bunq said it plans to address the regulator's concerns and continue pursuing a U.S. banking presence.

• The Dutch fintech firm reapplied for a U.S. bank charter in January after withdrawing ‌an earlier application at the start ​of 2024, Bloomberg News reported earlier this ​year.

• The company secured ​a FINRA-approved broker-dealer licence in 2025 that allows it ‌to offer investment products in the ​U.S. and had ​hoped to follow that with a full banking licence.

• Last month, the OCC also rejected Wise's application to become a ​national trust bank, ‌citing supervisory and compliance concerns. Wise has said it plans ​to submit a new application.

(Reporting by Rajveer Singh Pardesi ​in Bengaluru; Editing by Diti Pujara)

content_html_zh:
路透社

2026 年 8 月 7 日星期五下午 3:40（MST） 阅读 1 分钟

路透 8 月 7 日 - 荷兰金融科技公司 Bunq 周五表示，美国货币监理署 (OCC) 已拒绝其国家银行执照申请，这对该公司将银行业务扩展到美国的计划造成了挫折。

• “OCC 希望看到一项更专门针对美国市场的计划，在我们想要提供的产品方面拥有更丰富的经验，并详细介绍我们的财务结构，”Bunq 发言人在一份声明中告诉路透社。

• OCC 在 8 月 4 日的一封信中表示，其拒绝是由于“重大监管和合规问题”。

• OCC 表示，该申请没有明确解释 Bunq 将如何在美国进行资本化，并对管理层在无担保信用卡方面的经验以及该银行在竞争激烈的美国市场安全运营和盈利的能力提出了质疑。

• Bunq 表示，计划解决监管机构的担忧，并继续寻求在美国银行业开展业务。

• 据彭博新闻社今年早些时候报道，这家荷兰金融科技公司在 2024 年初撤回了先前的申请后，于 1 月重新申请了美国银行牌照。

• 该公司于 2025 年获得了 FINRA 批准的经纪交易商许可证，使其能够在美国提供投资产品。并希望随后获得完整的银行牌照。

• 上个月，OCC 还以监管和合规方面的担忧为由，拒绝了 Wise 成为国家信托银行的申请。 Wise 表示计划提交新的申请。

（班加罗尔 Rajveer Singh Pardesi 报道；Diti Pujara 编辑）
